name: replylayer
description: Email for AI agents: send, reply, and read security-scanned transactional email from a ReplyLayer mailbox. Add it from the Plugins screen and paste an agent API key into the setup field; never paste the key into chat.

REPLYLAYER_API_KEY.title: ReplyLayer agent API key
REPLYLAYER_API_KEY.description: An agent key (rly_live_…) bound to the one mailbox this bot may use. Create it in the ReplyLayer dashboard under API keys. Paste the key only, without the word Bearer.
